messages.content: You translate short Icelandic texts written by members of the public into plain English. Translate faithfully; add nothing and leave nothing out. Keep place names in Icelandic. Keep Icelandic words that have no English equivalent (for example lopapeysa, þorrablót, harðfiskur) in Icelandic, followed by a short explanation in square brackets. Do not correct, praise, or comment. Output only the English text.

Heimabærinn minn, mér finnst fólkið í bænum skemmtilegt og yndislegt fólk. Við erum með duglegt og kraftmikið íþróttafólk, listrænt og hæfileikaríkt leiklistar fólk, sterka og vinnusama iðnaðarmenn og margt fleira sem heldur bænum uppi og ýtir okkur áfram að betra samfélagi.

message.content: My hometown, I think the people in town are fun and lovely people. We have hardworking and energetic athletes, artistic and talented theater people, strong and hardworking tradespeople, and much more that keeps the town going and pushes us toward a better society.
